title: Spacious 4BR Pet-Friendly Home on 30A with a Community Pool
meta_description: Family Affair, a pet-friendly 4BR, 2BA private home on 30A in Santa Rosa Beach with an open floor plan, a deck, Xplorie benefits, and a shared pool. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, Family Affair is the perfect home base for your next 30A vacation. This comfortable four-bedroom, two-bathroom home accommodates up to eight guests and offers plenty of space to relax after a day at the beach. With two nearby beach accesses, a spacious fenced backyard, and easy access to the best of South Walton, you'll have everything you need for a memorable coastal getaway. Inside, the open-concept living area is designed for spending time together, featuring comfortable seating and a TV for movie nights or catching up after a day in the sun. The dining table seats eight, with additional seating at the kitchen peninsula, making family meals and game nights easy. The fully equipped kitchen includes everything needed to prepare your favorite meals, along with a coffee maker, toaster, and the convenience of an in-home washer and dryer. Step outside to enjoy the private fenced backyard, where you'll find a furnished patio and a fire pit with seating, the perfect place to gather in the evenings. Whether you're grilling, relaxing with your morning coffee, or winding down under the stars, the outdoor space adds another place for everyone to enjoy. With two beach accesses just moments away, spending your days on the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of Blue Mountain Beach couldn't be easier. You're also just minutes from local restaurants, coffee shops, boutique shopping, and the scenic Timpoochee Trail, making it easy to experience everything 30A has to offer. Sleeping Arrangements: Bedroom 1: King bed, tv, private bathroom with dual vanity mirror and walk in shower. Bedroom 2: Queen bed, tv and shared hallway bathroom. Bedroom 3: Queen bed, tv. Bedroom 4: Sofa that pulls out to a queen bed, and a tv. Explore Blue Mountain Beach Blue Mountain Beach offers a relaxed atmosphere with easy access to some of 30A's most popular destinations. Stop by the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for homemade ice cream, explore nearby Grayton Beach and Seaside, or head west toward Sandestin, Miramar Beach, and Destin for additional shopping, dining, golf, and entertainment. Whether you're biking Scenic Highway 30A, enjoying fresh seafood, or spending the day on the beach, there's something for every member of the family. Complimentary Xplorie Activities! Your stay at Family Affair includes complimentary access to Xplorie's popular attractions—one free admission per activity, per day (over $800 in added value). Enjoy golf at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise, Baytowne Adventure Zone, Big Kahuna's Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and complimentary bike rentals to explore Scenic 30A. Please Note: Complimentary Xplorie activities are only available for reservations of 1–27 consecutive nights. Stays of 28 nights or longer are not eligible for these complimentary activities. Additional Information: * Pet friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 20 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details. * Please, NO Smoking. * Parking for 2 cars only. * Please note that the garage is reserved for owner use only and will not be accessible to guests. * Open to snowbirds and month long rentals. Please contact us if you are interested. A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 2 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
